notes.title: v1.02: Survival mode fixes, sandbox mode, bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! v1.02 of One Troll Army is now available, woo!

We noticed an odd issue that somehow automatically added the DLC into people's shopping carts. It had something to do with the Steam overlay being called, and it's no longer happening. Apologies to anyone who this happened to! Wasn't intended. 

- Fixed the bug when a cutscene would sometimes not play at the end of a fort battle
- Removed the DLC adding bug
- Survival is now endless
- A steam achievement and counter for the most waves survived
- You can now die in Survival only once
- ESC now closes all open windows instead of popping up the menu
- For twitch integration, the best player of wave 1 gets a guaranteed spot in wave 2, it rewards to be the best player
- Fixed the achievement tied to number of kills
- Various GUI tidy-upness 

Keep on trollin!

notes.title: Update: dancing and bug-fixes!
notes.notes:
The first post-launch update for One Troll Army adds dancing to DLC owners (you're awesome!) and fixed a whole bunch of issues. 

Let us know what you think!

- Dance buttons for DLC owners added
- Fixed a bug where the Surrender button doesn't appear
- Rebalanced merc-orcs of level 2 and 3, they're now cheaper
- Fixed a rare issue when in the tutorial the game wouldn't respond
- Merc-orcs now appear on the second fort after beating the first fort
- Fixed a bug when waves wouldn't start
- Improved Troll behavior when collecting loot
- You can now skip the splash screens
